name: GitHub Integration
description: First real aish plugin — GitHub PR/issue automation. Exercises every plugin surface: an MCP server, two skills, three tools, webhook handlers, lifecycle hooks, output schemas, plugin memory, and a login handler.

owner.description: GitHub org/user that owns the repo this plugin acts on.

default_reviewers.description: GitHub logins auto-requested on PRs opened via create_pr.

triage_labels.description: Label vocabulary the issue-triage skill is allowed to apply.

auto_comment_on_open.description: When true, the issues webhook handler posts an acknowledgement comment on newly opened issues.
